verdict.rationale: ClickHouse ships clickhouse-local, a keyless, install-free single-binary version of ClickHouse for local SQL experimentation on local/remote files, confirmed by a runtime probe running a full CREATE/INSERT/SELECT roundtrip with no server, account, or production connection required — an ideal disposable sandbox for AI-native testing. clickhousectl also lets developers spin up local ClickHouse servers/versions independent of any cloud/production instance. missing for 10: explicit vendor-documented 'sandbox/staging cloud environment' distinct from production, and independent community confirmation specifically framed around avoiding production data.
